column1: # The P2 row set (plan Q0, frozen 2026-10-15; ADR 0011, ADR 0012, verification.md 3.2).
#  - the P1 rows (gates/rows/p1.tsv, p1=yes), copied with their text verbatim: the UE_IMPL parity
#    contract holds in every mode. Their cores are P1's; P2 scores them per mode.
#  - kaluza-sim's own ksim-p2.* rows: the split, OCUDU interop, AS security, the UP security policy,
#   p2          yes for every row here (anything else becomes a P3 row)
#   cores       stub, open5gs, kaluza (as in P1); open5gs=allow as in P1. uesim: the performance set,
#               inside kaluza-uesim against the VM-local scripted core (ADR 0011 point 9). card: the
#               burn, run by the user on the dev PC
#   modes       aio (P1's all-in-one), split (C2, our roles over real F1/E1), and the OCUDU combinations
#               C3 (OCUDU's CU-CP and CU-UP), C4 (OCUDU's CU-UP), C5 (OCUDU's CU-CP), ADR 0012. C4 and
#               C5 run on the stub only. A P1 row whose evidence is our CU-CP's NGAP is not scored in C3
#               or C5; one whose evidence is our CU-UP's N3 not in C3 or C4; the gNB- and AMF-restart rows
#               only in aio and split. In C3 and C5 the RAN release of the idle rows is OCUDU's inactivity
#   milestone   where the row is first scored. The P1 rows: Q3 in split mode, Q4 in C3, Q5 in C4/C5
#   mutant      the KSIM_MUTATIONS switch that must fail the row ('-': interop rows, whose control is the
#               peer; performance rows, whose control is the number; rows a P1 mutant already covers)
